name: GrandVista Restaurant
subtitle: Contemporary Fine Dining & Royal Indian Heritage

gallery.caption: The Grand Dining Hall with crystal chandeliers and intimate banquette seating
Signature Pan-Seared Himalayan Trout with Saffron Infusion
Grand Chocolate Sphere with Gold Dust and Fresh Berry Coulis
Courtyard Al Fresco Verandah overlooking the garden fountains

hours: Breakfast: 7:00 AM – 10:30 AM | Lunch: 12:30 PM – 3:30 PM | Dinner: 7:00 PM – 11:30 PM
dress_code: Smart Casual / Elegant Evening (Collared shirts, no flip-flops or athletic wear)
location: Main Lobby Level, East Wing Atrium
description: GrandVista Restaurant presents an epicurean journey marrying centuries-old royal culinary heritage with progressive global gastronomy. Under the guidance of our Master Executive Chef, each recipe honors heritage spices, sustainable farm-to-table produce, and theatrical table-side presentations.

signature_dishes.name: Royal Saffron Dum Biryani
signature_dishes.description: Slow-cooked aged basmati rice layered with aromatic saffron, marinated meat or royal wild mushrooms, sealed with artisanal whole wheat dough.

signature_dishes.name: Truffled Morel & Paneer Tikka
signature_dishes.description: Charcoal-smoked cottage cheese stuffed with Kashmiri morels, glazed in black truffle butter and hung curd marinade.

signature_dishes.name: Grand Cru Chocolate Sphere
signature_dishes.description: 70% Valrhona dark chocolate dome melted table-side with warm Madagascar bourbon vanilla ganache and raspberry coulis.

name: Sky Lounge & Rooftop Bar
subtitle: Panoramic Skyline Views, Tapas & Mixology

gallery.caption: Rooftop observation terrace with illuminated skyline vistas
Bespoke Oak-Smoked Bourbon Cocktail crafted by our Resident Mixologist
Starlit lounge cabanas with fire pits and plush lounge sofas
Gourmet Robata Skewers and Mediterranean mezze platters

hours: Evening & Nightly: 5:00 PM – 1:00 AM (Live Resident DJ from 8:00 PM)
dress_code: Chic Evening / Glamour (Collared shirts for gentlemen, smart evening footwear)
description: Perched on the 14th floor commanding uninterrupted 360-degree vistas across the capital skyline, Sky Lounge is the city's premier evening sanctuary. Sip bespoke barrel-aged concoctions, rare vintage malts, and sample artisanal small plates while listening to soothing deep ambient house grooves under the open sky.

signature_dishes.name: Smoked Hickory Old Fashioned
signature_dishes.description: Single barrel bourbon infused with orange zest, Angostura bitters, served under a cloche with fresh hickory wood smoke.

signature_dishes.name: Glazed Pork Belly / Tofu Robata Skewers
signature_dishes.description: Slow-braised skewers caramelized over binchotan charcoal with yuzu honey reduction and toasted sesame.

signature_dishes.name: Truffle Edamame & Parmesan Dumplings
signature_dishes.description: Steamed crystal dumplings filled with crushed edamame, shaved black truffles, and aged parmesan broth.

name: The Grand Café
subtitle: Artisanal Boulangerie, Viennoiserie & Single-Origin Roasts

gallery.caption: Sunlit European brass & marble café atrium with fresh morning pastry displays
Handcrafted Parisian Macarons and seasonal French fruit tartlets
Sun-dappled courtyard garden patio for relaxed morning coffee and books
Freshly baked sourdough tartines with avocado, smoked salmon, and poached egg

hours: Daily: 6:30 AM – 10:00 PM (Fresh oven bakes at 7:00 AM, 11:30 AM, and 4:00 PM)
description: The Grand Café is an intimate, sun-dappled haven evoking Parisian boulevards. Savor morning sourdough croissants baked fresh throughout the day, pour-over specialty Arabica coffees from Chikmagalur estates, and bespoke afternoon high tea tiered stands served in bone china.

signature_dishes.name: Chikmagalur Pour-Over Single Origin
signature_dishes.description: Shade-grown specialty coffee brewed manually table-side with citrus and bittersweet dark cocoa undertones.

signature_dishes.name: Almond Croissant & Wild Berry Tart
signature_dishes.description: Flaky hand-laminated butter croissant filled with frangipane cream, paired with fresh seasonal berries.

signature_dishes.name: Avocado & Burrata Sourdough Tartine
signature_dishes.description: Crusty wood-fired sourdough toast topped with Hass avocado, creamy artisanal burrata, heirloom cherry tomatoes, and basil oil.
